verdict.rationale: Ramp documents conversational policy help through Ramp MCP, where employees can "get policy answers directly from their daily tools," and the AI Agents guide lists policy Q&A. Missing-receipt chasing is covered by an MCP example prompt that finds missing receipts and drafts reminders, CLI commands such as flag-missing and explain-missing, automated reminders, and SMS/Slack/Teams submission. Travel policy questions can also be asked over SMS or Slack. Missing for 10: any evidence that the assistant explains card declines, a demonstrated pre-spend "can I expense this?" exchange for general (non-travel) spend, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
